title: A notes-only commit changes only the notes lines its own PR added
why: Lane past-ruling-on-send (session_013NEJL3ZtjRrvWWB5nAzQiv), 14:51 CST Nov 8: on PR #2041 (verdict-run-not-read) a record-writer's brief named notes by the prefix `verdict-`, so its notes-only commit added Fix lines to 12 notes that belong to the verdict wrapper tool, not to this PR. The lane restored them in f9d09b9bf. Harm: a notes-only commit silently rewrote other lanes' debt notes, and only a hand check of the diff caught it.
note: Coordinator 16:08 CST Nov 8: scope unchanged; #2289 ships it. The wider check is step agent-commit-file-scope.
